jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Manager

Boston, MA • Full-time

 

About our Company

Government’s biggest challenges — homelessness, election administration, emergency response — don’t get solved inside a single agency. Work happens across dozens of organizations that often struggle to coordinate, share information, and act in real time.

Civic Roundtable is an AI-powered government operations platform that helps public servants do exactly that. We give wide networks of agencies and partner organizations the tools to consolidate information, coordinate mission-critical work, and move faster together so the people on the frontlines of public problems have what they need to serve their communities.

Trusted by 4,000+ organizations across all 50 states, Civic Roundtable emerged from the Harvard Innovation Labs and is backed by General Catalyst.

 

About the Role

We're looking for our first product hire beyond our Head of Product. Roundtable's product surface has grown quickly: collaborative spaces, a CRM, Documents, Forms, Events, and an AI layer running across all of it. You'll take ownership of a meaningful slice of it, working alongside an engineering manager and a pod of engineers. There's no roadmap process to administer, no analytics team to request numbers from, no research org to hand discovery to - you'll do that work yourself, and you'll shape how we do it from here.

You'll report to our Head of Product and work daily with engineering, design, and our deployments team. This role is based in Boston, in-person at least 1 day a week.

 

What You'll Do

  • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle - Own core product areas and be accountable for outcomes, from ideation and strategy to execution and launch.

  • Engage directly with customers - Run user interviews, workflow mapping, usability testing, shadowing, competitive research, and data analysis. Work with Customer Success and Sales to understand pain points, and translate those insights into high-impact product investments.

  • Drive high-velocity execution with engineering and design - Translate strategy into intuitive experiences that are built to scale. Help engineers and designers understand users deeply enough to make great product decisions and iterate rapidly.

  • Define what success looks like - Set success metrics before you build, make sure the right things get instrumented, and review outcomes after launch.

  • Land the launch - Craft messaging that resonates with users, enable Sales and Marketing to win with customers, and drive cross-functional readiness across teams.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years in product management - A track record of shipping high-quality products end-to-end, from discovery and definition through launch and iteration, ideally in B2B SaaS. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, with urgency and ownership, in fast-paced, low-structure environments.

  • High agency - You bring structure to ambiguous problem spaces and move without being told. You have a bias to action and have a scrappy high-ownership mentality, willing to QA, debug alongside an engineer, or backstop a customer team when that's what the team requires.

  • Strong product, user, and business instincts - You care how products feel and fit into someone's daily work, and you balance user needs, domain complexity, and system constraints to find the high-leverage improvements. You find the real need underneath a customer request and prioritize by impact, zooming out to vertical-level strategy and back down to precise workflow nuance.

  • Excellent communication - You can articulate a product vision and the tradeoffs behind it to diverse audiences including customers, engineers, executives, and cross-functional teams.

  • Fluency with metrics and experimentation - Use data to test ideas, learn from user feedback, and iterate quickly.

  • Hands-on AI experience - You've built agents, prototypes, or AI-powered workflows yourself. You consistently and creatively apply AI to improve your own product processes.

 

Why You’ll Love Working @ Civic Roundtable

  • You'll have a competitive salary, meaningful equity, health benefits, and flexible work arrangements as part of our first 30 employees

  • You'll build products that help government work better for millions of people, from delivering housing services to supporting elections, emergency response, and veterans.

  • You'll work directly with founders every day and have real influence on the product, company, and culture from the ground floor as one of our first 30 employees.

  • You'll help define what AI-native software looks like for the public sector, turning emerging capabilities into products that solve real problems for public servants.

  • You'll tackle complex coordination problems that span organizations, agencies, and systems, where there’s no established playbook or obvious product category to copy.

  • You'll build, ship, learn, and iterate quickly. You’ll have the autonomy to make high-quality product decisions, turn insight into action, and ship features that have an immediate, measurable impact.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you’re passionate about building great products and making a difference, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Deployments Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Deployments Lead

About our Company

Government’s biggest challenges — homelessness, election administration, emergency response — don’t get solved inside a single agency. Work happens across dozens of organizations that often struggle to coordinate, share information, and act in real time.

Civic Roundtable is an AI-powered government operations platform that helps public servants do exactly that. We give wide networks of agencies and partner organizations the tools to consolidate information, coordinate mission-critical work, and move faster together so the people on the frontlines of public problems have what they need to serve their communities.

Trusted by 4,000+ organizations across all 50 states, Civic Roundtable emerged from the Harvard Innovation Labs and is backed by General Catalyst. Recently named Fast Company 2026 Next Big Things in Tech honoree!

About the Role
As a Deployments Lead at Civic Roundtable, you will be the linchpin in fostering robust customer relationships and ensuring maximum usage of the Roundtable Platform. As a senior individual contributor you'll work directly with public servants — emergency managers, election administrators, homelessness response teams, and other government leaders — helping them get measurable value from Roundtable as they serve their communities.

You’ll manage a portfolio of large enterprise accounts with complex multi-stakeholder deployments, leading each project through kick-off through implementation, launch, and renewal. You’ll be a strategic voice for the Deployments team: owning quarterly strategic goals, writing playbooks for new use cases, and identifying opportunities for growing our footprint within agencies.

The best candidate for this role is a seasoned, self-directed deployments lead who is equally comfortable presenting to an agency executive and troubleshooting a platform issue, who thrives in ambiguity and proactively identifies and sets up new processes, and who serves as a relentless advocate for both our customers and the Deployments team internally. People who thrive in this role often come from past deployments or customer success roles, consulting, complex project or program management, or client-facing roles where they owned both the relationship and the delivery.

The Deployment Lead Role is fully remote with expectation to travel to client sites as needed. Role is open to all with preference of those in the Oregon or the Pacific Northwest.

What You’ll Do

Key Responsibilities:

  • Portfolio Ownership: Independently manage a portfolio of large enterprise customer accounts. Own and secure renewals for every customer in your portfolio, including managing at-risk accounts. Set goals with each customer and proactively report progress against them. Manage contract reporting requirements such as hour reporting and quarterly audit reports.

  • Executive Relationship Management: Build trusted relationships above the project level, with executive sponsors and agency leadership. Deliver end-of-year strategic presentations to executive sponsors that combine quantitative and qualitative insights on impact.

  • Complex Deployments: Lead customers through discovery, visioning, configuration, and launch on projects where the path is ambiguous, facilitating in-person sessions when appropriate. Draft deployment playbooks for net-new use cases.

  • Expansion & Growth: Identify opportunities to grow contract size and run brainstorming sessions on expanding Roundtable to additional departments. Spot trends across your sectors, run sector-specific webinars, and raise growth opportunities to the team.

  • Deployments Strategy: Independently own a quarterly team goal and run meetings with internal and external stakeholders to deliver it. Contribute to the direction of the Deployments org and help make tradeoff decisions that balance customer needs with company strategy.

  • Training Strategy: Design training strategies for large projects, and tailor training for different audiences — from executives and CTOs to end users.

  • Advanced Support: Serve as the first escalation point for complex support issues before involving technical SMEs. Bring working fluency in topics like SSO, and custom development options.

What We’re Looking For

We’re hoping you are:

  • Strategic and Customer-centric: You care deeply about customer outcomes and can connect day-to-day work to an agency’s bigger goals.

  • A Trusted Advisor to Leaders: Confident building relationships with and presenting to senior government officials and executive sponsors.

  • Calm Under Pressure: Skilled at navigating at-risk accounts, hard conversations, and competing priorities with steady judgment.

  • Commercially Minded: You see renewal and expansion as the natural result of delivering real value, and you spot growth opportunities early.

  • Proactive and Self-Driven: Eager to take initiative, bring structure to ambiguity, and drive projects and team goals forward independently.

  • Process-oriented and Tech-forward: Excited to design new workflows and experiment with AI tools to make our deployments more efficient, scalable, and impactful.

  • Mission-aligned: Energized by the idea of making government work better, and curious about how public-sector agencies operate.

  • Self starter: Comfortable setting own direction and handling ambiguity. Based on the west coast, bonus if located in Oregon or the Pacific Northwest.

  • Open to travel (please expect 20% of time on the road).

  • Fully comfortable working in a remote environment while maintaining flexible working hours to ensure seamless collaboration with our team and partners.

We’re hoping you have:

  • 5 years+ of experience in customer success, deployments, implementation, or a related field, preferably within the government and / or technology sector.

  • A track record of owning a portfolio of high-value accounts, including managing renewals and turning around at-risk customers.

  • Experience building relationships with and presenting to executive stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Technical aptitude: Comfort with software configuration and technical topics such as SSO, integrations, and data requests.

  • Problem-solving skills: A keen ability to diagnose issues, think critically, and design creative solutions.

  • Bonus: Prior experience working with or in government, civic tech, or mission-driven organizations.

Why You’ll Love Working @ Civic Roundtable

  • You’ll help government work better for millions of people, from delivering housing services to supporting elections, emergency response, and veterans.

  • You’ll help define what AI-native deployments look like for the public sector, turning emerging capabilities into better outcomes for public servants.

  • You’ll tackle complex coordination problems that span agencies, partners, and systems — often with no established playbook, so you’ll get to write it.

  • You’ll get broad exposure across customers, product, and growth, with the autonomy to turn customer insight into action and see the impact quickly.

  • You'll have a competitive salary, meaningful equity, health benefits, and flexible work arrangements as part of our first 30 employees.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you’re passionate about building great products and making a difference, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Head of Marketing

About our Company

Government’s biggest challenges — homelessness, election administration, emergency response — don’t get solved inside a single agency. Work happens across dozens of organizations that often struggle to coordinate, share information, and act in real time.

Civic Roundtable is an AI-powered government operations platform that helps public servants do exactly that. We give wide networks of agencies and partner organizations the tools to consolidate information, coordinate mission-critical work, and move faster together so the people on the frontlines of public problems have what they need to serve their communities.

Trusted by thousands of organizations across all 50 states, Civic Roundtable emerged from the Harvard Innovation Labs and is backed by General Catalyst.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Head of Marketing to lead the marketing function for Civic Roundtable’s next stage of growth.

You’ll set the strategy across brand, positioning, product marketing, growth, and field marketing, while building on a strong foundation already in place. You’ll lead a lean team that includes a growth marketer who owns demand generation and field marketing and a marketing designer, and work directly with our founders, Sales, Product, and customer-facing teams.

This is a hands-on leadership role. We’re looking for someone who can set direction, help the team do its best work, and jump in where they can add the most leverage — whether that’s sharpening our positioning, developing a major campaign, shaping our event strategy, supporting a strategic deal, or helping us understand what’s actually creating pipeline.

You’ll report directly to the CEO and be the senior marketing voice on the leadership team. This role can be remote, with a preference for candidates based in Boston or New York.

What You’ll Do

  • Own our brand and positioning — Turn a complex product and emerging category into a simple, compelling story about what Civic Roundtable is, why it matters, and why now.

  • Turn customer and product momentum into great marketing — Translate customer stories, product launches, and proof points into campaigns, content, thought leadership, and sales materials.

  • Set our growth strategy — Partner closely with our growth marketer to identify the audiences, channels, campaigns, and investments most likely to create qualified pipeline, and help connect what we learn back to company and GTM strategy.

  • Build a differentiated field strategy — Work with our growth marketer and sales team to make conferences, roundtables, dinners, partnerships, and other in-person moments a powerful part of how we build relationships and grow accounts.

  • Make marketing a true partner to sales — Work closely with our sales team on strategic accounts, messaging, enablement, and campaigns that help us open, close, and expand government relationships.

  • Build our category and voice — Use thought leadership, PR, partnerships, and creative campaigns to establish Civic Roundtable as a defining voice in modern government operations and AI.

  • Lead and grow the marketing team — Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, create the conditions for great work, and determine where we should invest as the company scales.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years in marketing at high-growth companies — You’ve helped build marketing at an early- or growth-stage B2B software company and understand what it takes to scale a marketing function as the company grows.

  • Exceptional brand and positioning instincts — You can take something complicated and make it feel obvious, differentiated, and memorable. You know how to sharpen a company story as the product and market evolve.

  • Strong product marketing and storytelling skills — You know how to get close to customers and product, find the insight that matters, and turn it into messaging, launches, campaigns, and content that resonate.

  • Deep understanding of growth — You know how to build pipeline in a relationship-driven enterprise market through ABM, field marketing, events, partnerships, and demand generation. You can identify what works, make it repeatable, and partner closely with Sales on growth strategy.

  • A hands-on builder — You’re not looking to manage marketing from a distance. You’re excited to personally write and edit copy, dig into campaign performance, work in HubSpot, build a deck, shape an event, or jump into a strategic account alongside the team. You know when to lead, when to coach, and when to roll up your sleeves and do the work yourself.

  • A strong people leader and collaborator — You know how to set direction for talented functional owners, give them room to own their work, and make them better. You build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, and customer-facing teams.

  • High agency and startup energy — You bring structure to ambiguity, move quickly, and are comfortable with a lean team, imperfect information, and building the process while doing the work.

  • AI-native and tool-fluent — You actively use and experiment with AI in your own work and are excited to help the team do the same. You look for ways to use AI, automation, analytics, and new tools to help a small team operate with outsized impact.

Why You’ll Love Working @ Civic Roundtable

  • You’ll have a competitive salary, meaningful equity, health benefits, and flexible work arrangements as part of an early-stage, fast-growing team.

  • You’ll have real ownership. You’ll work directly with the founders and leadership team and have significant influence over how we tell our story, build our category, and grow the company.

  • You’ll inherit a talented, lean team with room to shape how the function grows, rather than starting from scratch or stepping into a large organization with an established playbook.

  • You’ll have an unusual amount of raw material to work with: passionate customers, hundreds of proof points and stories, strong market momentum, and a product that solves real and urgent problems.

  • You’ll help define a new category at the intersection of government operations, collaboration, and AI — and shape how the market understands what modern government software can look like.

  • You’ll build, ship, learn, and iterate quickly. You’ll have the autonomy to try ambitious ideas, see what works, and build the marketing organization you believe this company needs.

  • Most importantly, you’ll build marketing for a product that helps public servants do some of the country’s most important work, from helping veterans find housing to preparing communities for emergencies.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you’re excited to build an exceptional brand and growth engine while helping government work better, we want to hear from you!
